Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're seeking a strategic Staff Product Marketing Manager to build and lead the go-to-market strategy for Discord's Unified Developer Platform, focused on helping game developers and publishers build richer social experiences, grow their communities, and deepen player engagement through Discord's platform.

You'll drive product adoption by building robust go-to-market and Business Development enablement programs, defining activation goals, and partnering closely with Business Development, Developer Operations, Product, and Developer Relations to successfully bring new platform capabilities to market. This role will play a key part in accelerating adoption of Discord's Unified Developer Platform across the Gaming industry.

If you're a self-starter and team player who excels in fast-paced environments and zero to scale projects, this is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Discord's developer ecosystem and shape the future of our platform business. We're looking for an experienced, strategic PMM who is passionate about developers, gaming, and building products that enable partners to succeed.

What You'll Be Doing

· Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Discord's developer platform through market research, customer segmentation, competitive analysis, and targeted programs that drive developer awareness, adoption, and long-term platform growth.

· Lead activation initiatives across Discord's platform portfolio by crafting differentiated messaging, value propositions, positioning, and go-to-market motions that resonate with game developers and publishers.

· Build and scale impactful Business Development and Developer Operations enablement programs—including training, playbooks, product collateral, competitive positioning, implementation guidance, objection handling, and customer-facing tools—to empower internal teams to successfully bring Discord's platform to market.

· Define and track platform adoption goals, activation KPIs, and business metrics, continuously refining go-to-market strategies to improve developer adoption and create scalable, repeatable growth.

· Act as the voice of developers and strategic partners, translating customer insights into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, and future platform investments.

· Partner with Business Marketing, Developer Relations, and Communications to establish Discord's thought leadership within the gaming developer ecosystem through industry events, customer stories, technical content, and strategic partnerships.

· Lead cross-functional go-to-market planning and execution across Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Developer Operations, Developer Relations, Marketing, Design, and Legal to ensure successful product launches and organizational readiness.

What you should have

· 7+ years of Product Marketing experience in B2B technology, gaming, developer platforms, SaaS, APIs, SDKs, or platform businesses.

· Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical products and driving adoption through Business Development, Partnerships, or other customer-facing teams.

· Experience building scalable enablement programs, including messaging, positioning, launch materials, training, playbooks, and customer collateral.

· Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, technical audiences, and how to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling customer value propositions.

· Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.

· Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and excitement for building new products, business models, and go-to-market motions from the ground up.

· Passion for gaming, developers, and helping partners build successful communities on Discord.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $204,000 to $229,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

Gusto is looking for a seasoned performance marketer to own execution across paid social and emerging acquisition channels — testing new platforms, formats, and tactics to find what works before scaling. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of performance marketing, channel experimentation, and AI-powered workflow design.

You will own execution and day-to-day strategy for paid social and new channel tests, working within Gusto's demand generation framework, with clear accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.

As a member of Gusto’s Demand Generation team, you will be embedded specifically within Paid Acquisition, a focused group responsible for driving awareness and pipeline through paid media. This team operates with high autonomy, a bias for experimentation, and a culture of cross-functional partnership. We hold ourselves to a high standard, move fast, and genuinely believe that being AI-native is part of what it means to do this job well today.

· Own paid social strategy and execution across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, and TikTok, driving full-funnel campaigns from brand awareness through retargeting and conversion, with accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.

· Manage significant, multi-million dollar budgets with rigor, including campaign pacing, forecasting, budget-vs-actuals analysis, and making the case for paid social investment in imperfect attribution environments.

· Apply and help refine Gusto's paid acquisition measurement framework, including attribution philosophy and budget allocation principles, in partnership with the broader marketing team.

· Lead creative strategy and testing at scale: briefing creative studios and agencies, structuring meaningful experiments, interpreting complex data sets to drive actionable insights, and building a clear learning roadmap.

· Serve as the team's go-to expert on paid social and AI-powered marketing workflows, documenting playbooks and best practices for the paid acquisition team.

· Identify, test, and validate new digital media channels and formats beyond core paid social — such as Google Demand Generation campaigns and ChatGPT ads — running structured pilots, defining success criteria upfront, and making the call on scale vs. kill within existing budget guardrails.

· Support new product launches from 0-1 by building and executing the paid acquisition plan for launch moments — channel mix, budget, creative, and timeline — in partnership with Integrated Marketing and Product Marketing.

· Partner with Web Marketing to align on landing page strategy, message match, and post-click conversion, because paid social performance doesn't end at the click.

· Use AI tools as a consistent, habitual part of your workflow: generating campaign briefs, developing copy variants, accelerating audience research, and building reusable systems that raise the bar for the whole team.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Communications, and Web to align paid social with integrated campaigns and earned media moments, and bring performance data back upstream to influence creative production and asset strategy.

· 7+ years of performance marketing experience at a B2B SaaS, performance marketing agency, or high-growth consumer organization, with deep expertise in paid social and a track record of testing and scaling new channels.

· Full-funnel ownership across two or more major paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, TikTok), including deep, hands-on, in-platform execution (campaign builds, audience/targeting strategy, creative testing, bid/budget management), with significant budget responsibility and a track record of driving measurable pipeline impact.

· Strong creative strategy and testing instincts: you know how to structure a test, distinguish a learning from a result, and translate performance data into creative direction.

· AI-fluent in practice, not just in theory; you use AI tools consistently in your day-to-day workflow to accelerate briefs, copy, and analysis, and have a track record of implementing AI-driven efficiencies for your team.

· Excellent cross-functional collaborator who can translate integrated briefs into paid social strategy, advocate for what the channel needs, and work effectively alongside brand, web, and comms partners.

· You are analytical and data-driven, with a clear point of view on attribution in imperfect measurement environments and comfort communicating paid social's contribution to business outcomes.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $108,570/yr to $133,000/yr in Denver and $131,430/yr to $161,000/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Schick uns Deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf, kleinem Motivationsschreiben und Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).

Du bringst Demand Generation und Vertrieb auf eine gemeinsame Linie und machst deine Wirkung über klare Kennzahlen sichtbar. In unserem AI-first-Umfeld hast du den Freiraum, dir die Tools und Strukturen aufzubauen, die du dafür brauchst.

Aufbau und Steuerung von Demand Generation: Du sorgst für ein konstantes Aufkommen qualifizierter Leads und probierst dabei kontinuierlich Neues aus.
Signal-based Marketing: Du arbeitest mit Intent-Daten, Business-Triggern und Account-Signalen und leitest daraus ab, welche Accounts wann mit welcher Botschaft angesprochen werden.
Gestaltung von Funnel und Conversion: Du baust den Lead-Funnel und die Customer Journey vom ersten Touchpoint bis zur Sales-Opportunity auf, inklusive Landingpages, Conversion-Strecke ins CRM und A/B-Tests.

Sicherheit im Growth-Stack und in Paid: Du kennst dich mit Marketing Automation, CRM und Performance-Kanälen wie LinkedIn Ads und Google Ads/SEA aus. Erfahrung mit signalbasiertem Marketing und KI-gestützten Workflows ist ein klarer Pluspunkt.

Dein Marketing spricht genau diese Unternehmen an. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echtem Business Impact.
Lerne schnell und arbeite AI-first: Wir nutzen AI als Teil unseres Arbeitsalltags für Recherche, Prototyping, Analyse, Kommunikation, Automatisierung und bessere Entscheidungen.
Flexibles Arbeiten: Wir vertrauen dir, gute Arbeit zu leisten. Der Fokus liegt auf Ergebnissen, Zusammenarbeit und Verlässlichkeit. Dazu gehören hybrides Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub und ein halber Urlaubstag als Geschenk zu deinem Geburtstag.
Lernen & Entwicklung: SaaS und AI verändern sich rasant, und wir uns mit ihnen. Deshalb investieren wir in Lernen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
Team & Austausch: Bei Valsight bekommst du Kontext, Vertrauen und Raum, Dinge voranzubringen. Wir arbeiten direkt und teamübergreifend zusammen und nutzen bewusst das Wissen aller. Weekly Shows, All-Hands mit Ask-Me-Anything und Team-Events machen genau das im Alltag sichtbar.
Standort: Unser Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg ist gut angebunden. Vierbeiner sind willkommen.
Office: Unser Büro soll ein Ort sein, an den du gern kommst. Dafür sorgen wir: mit Frühstück, Getränken und Snacks deiner Wahl, höhenverstellbaren Tischen und der Ausstattung, die du dir wünschst.

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Specialist, EU (European Region) to support the execution, optimization, and operational management of paid media campaigns across key EU markets.
This role is highly execution-focused and ideal for someone with hands-on paid media experience, strong attention to detail, and a passion for campaign operations, performance analysis, creative testing, and process improvement. The Growth Marketing Specialist will help implement campaign strategies, monitor performance, coordinate creative and localization workflows, maintain reporting accuracy, and ensure campaigns are launched and optimized efficiently across EU platforms.

Execute and support paid media campaigns across assigned EU markets, including campaign setup, QA, launch, monitoring, pacing, optimization, and reporting.
Manage day-to-day campaign operations across global and EU-specific performance platforms, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Apple Search Ads, and other relevant regional paid media platforms.
Implement campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, creative rotations, tracking parameters, and platform settings based on approved growth plans.
Monitor campaign performance daily and identify issues related to spend pacing, delivery, tracking, creative fatigue, audience performance, conversion rates, CAC, ROAS, and other core KPIs.
Support optimization of paid media campaigns against goals such as new customer acquisition, revenue, ROAS, CAC, LTV, payback period, contribution margin, and conversion rate.
Assist with budget pacing and reallocation recommendations across markets, platforms, campaigns, ad groups, audiences, and creative assets.
Support structured testing roadmaps across creative, audiences, bids, landing pages, campaign structures, offers, localization, and platform features.
Coordinate performance creative workflows, including briefing, asset trafficking, localization, naming conventions, version control, approvals, uploads, and post-launch performance tracking.
Partner with creative, localization, and regional stakeholders to ensure ads are accurate, culturally relevant, platform-compliant, and aligned with performance testing needs.
Analyze performance creative by format, hook, message, offer, language, market, audience, placement, and funnel stage.
Maintain campaign documentation, testing trackers, launch calendars, QA checklists, naming conventions, UTM standards, and reporting processes.
Support measurement initiatives including incrementality tests, geo tests, platform lift studies, holdout tests, attribution analysis, and cohort reporting.
Prepare recurring performance reports, insights summaries, test readouts, and campaign performance updates for managers and cross-functional partners.
QA tracking, attribution, pixels, conversion events, product feeds, landing URLs, UTMs, and campaign taxonomy to ensure reporting accuracy.
Work with analytics, data science, and measurement partners to validate campaign data and troubleshoot reporting discrepancies.
Support agency, platform partner, and vendor coordination, including campaign requests, asset delivery, performance follow-ups, billing inputs, and meeting preparation.
Monitor E platform updates, regional media trends, auction dynamics, competitive shifts, and performance benchmarks.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, campaign QA, reporting quality, creative testing processes, and execution speed.
The duties and responsibilities described above may provide only a partial description of this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all aspects of the job. Other duties and responsibilities not outlined in this document may be added as necessary or desirable, with or without notice.

Hands-on experience executing or supporting paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Apple Search Ads, or similar performance channels.
Experience with E-specific platforms, or similar regional paid media platforms strongly preferred.
Strong campaign operations skills, including campaign setup, trafficking, QA, budget pacing, naming conventions, tracking, and performance reporting.

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten.

Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein!

Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...
Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel . Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen.

Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
Teamlunch : Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!
Stellenanforderungen

Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.
Struktur: Du bist strukturiert, verlässlich und behältst auch mit mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
Stakeholder: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional und kannst zwischen Sales, Marketing und externen Partnern vermitteln.
Verfügbarkeit: Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig (mind. 50% der wöchentlichen Zeit) im Büro sein.
Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.
Klingt das nach einer Stelle, in der du etwas bewegen kannst und möchtest? Dann meld’ dich bei uns! Wir freuen uns schon auf ein Gespräch mit dir!

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them.

You'll take the customers we already have, figure out how to get them more value from Workleap, and build and run the programs that deliver it. You'll own the channels, the messaging, and the results.

Proven ability to translate positioning into messaging and marketing campaigns, tailored to specific audiences;
Track record of running marketing programs from conception to execution, shaping the idea, briefing creative, and shipping the work yourself when needed;

Leading and owning customer marketing, setting direction for your own programs.
Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

Annual bonus program.
LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
Flexible vacation policy.
Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
In-person gathering twice a year.
Claude access, for everyone.

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.
We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.
If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

Transparency is how we hire — for you and for us.
Your journey starts with a recruiter conversation, followed by a virtual interview with the hiring manager and one additional interviewer.
